title: Code and results for: A participation-ratio diagnostic, validated in simulation, for choosing between sparsity-adaptive and multivariate EWMA charts for mean shifts
description: Python/Numba run-length engine for MEWMA, BAS-EWMA, G-BAS and competing sparsity-adaptive charts; analysis scripts with fixed random seeds for the simulation study and the Tennessee Eastman and WaDi case studies; and a function returning the gain curve and break-even participation ratio for a user-specified configuration. Data (Tennessee Eastman, WaDi) are not redistributed; see README.
